changes.before: Active as of 2026-09-23, running toward its 180-day statutory ceiling (~2026-12-15). The county's Planning & Community Development Department, working with consultant Entech Engineering, introduced a full draft curative amendment (covering power sourcing, water supply, permitted zones, setbacks, noise, and decommissioning) to the County Planning Commission in September 2026; Commission Chair Jason Bogle stressed it remains a draft, and public-comment hearings before the Board of Commissioners were expected to begin around mid-November 2026, ahead of the statutory deadline. Commissioner Marc Sortman has repeatedly clarified that the county's own zoning authority covers only the 19 municipalities in its zoning partnership (which does not include Muncy Township, a separate PA MPC curative-amendment moratorium already tracked in this inventory as pa-muncy-township-2026); other municipalities must adopt their own ordinances.
changes.after: June 18 minutes record 3-0 approval of Resolution 2026-16 and describe a data-center stopgap pending an ordinance.
